story.title: The dodo bird had a secret sensory world scientists are only now discovering
story.reason: Overturns old misconceptions about the dodo, revealing a clever and sensory-rich creature that charms the imagination.
story.title_ja: ドードー鳥の知られざる感覚の世界：旧来のイメージを覆す発見
story.reason_ja: おっとりしたイメージだったドードー鳥が、実は豊かな感覚を持つ賢い鳥だったことが分かり、昔の誤解を解く微笑ましいニュースです。
story.jp_copy: これまでのイメージとは異なり、絶滅したドードー鳥が実は豊かな感覚世界と知性を持っていたことが最新の研究で判明しました。長年の誤解が解け、ドードー鳥の賢く魅力的な素顔が明らかになる、知的好奇心に満ちた嬉しい発見です。
story.en_copy: Long misunderstood, the dodo bird is now being revealed as a clever creature with a rich sensory world. Scientists are overturning old misconceptions, giving us a fresh and charming perspective on a smart bird whose true nature is finally being appreciated.
story.duck_jp: ドードー鳥は実はとっても賢かったんですね！誤解が解けて良かった！
story.duck_en: The dodo was clever all along! Glad history is setting the record straight.
story.x_jp: 鈍感だと思われていたドードー鳥の秘密が解明！実は豊かな感覚と知性を持った賢い鳥だったことが分かりました。
story.x_en: New discoveries show the dodo bird was actually clever and sensory-rich, overturning old misconceptions!

concepts.title_ja: 研究室での新しい発見
concepts.title_en: Lab Discovery of the Clever Dodo
concepts.concept_ja: 明るく清潔な研究室で、白衣を着たダック記者がドードー鳥の模型と向き合い、豊かな感覚世界を裏付ける最新科学の発見を調べるシーン。
concepts.concept_en: In a bright, modern research lab, The Daily Duck mascot in a mini lab coat examines a friendly dodo bird figure surrounded by glowing sensory indicators, celebrating the new scientific finding.
concepts.composition_ja: 明るい現代風の研究室デスク。黄色いダック（オレンジのくちばし、黒くつややかな目、頭の毛束、温かい表情）が虫眼鏡を手に持ち、スマートな表情のドードー鳥の模型を興味深く観察しています。周囲には視覚・嗅覚・聴覚を象徴する優しい光の粒子や花のモチーフが浮かんでいます。
concepts.composition_en: A bright, modern laboratory setting. The iconic friendly yellow duck mascot (orange beak, dark glossy eyes, feather tuft, warm expression) wears a cute mini lab coat and holds a magnifying glass, looking excitedly at a friendly dodo bird figure. Gentle glowing icons representing senses float nearby in soft pastel colors.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Editorial 3D digital visual for news story. A cute yellow duck mascot with orange beak, large glossy dark eyes, small feather tuft, and a warm friendly expression wearing a mini white lab coat. The duck holds a magnifying glass next to a sleek, charming dodo bird model on a clean desk. Soft glowing pastel visual effects represent rich senses with vibrant flowers and subtle sparkles. Bright, soft studio lighting, clean modern editorial style, high resolution, 3D render feel, cheerful tone.
concepts.alt_ja: 白衣を着たイエローダックが研究室でドードー鳥の模型と豊かな感覚を表す光を観察しているイラスト
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck mascot in a mini lab coat observing a friendly dodo bird model surrounded by soft sensory sparkles in a bright lab.

concepts.title_en: Island Encounter in the Dodo's World
concepts.concept_ja: 陽光あふれる豊かな島で、ダックとドードー鳥が一緒に歩きながら、ドードーの優れた感覚と知性を探検する自然豊かなシーン。
concepts.concept_en: On a sunlit tropical island, The Daily Duck walks alongside a smart, friendly dodo bird who gracefully navigates the lush forest using its keen senses.
concepts.composition_ja: 青空と鮮やかな植物が広がる美しい島の森。黄色いダック（オレンジのくちばし、黒いつややかな目、小さな羽の房）が探検帽をかぶり、賢そうな目のドードー鳥と一緒に並んで歩いています。ドードー鳥は鋭い嗅覚で珍しい果実を嬉しそうに見つけています。
concepts.composition_en: A vibrant, sun-dappled tropical island forest. The iconic yellow duck mascot with orange beak and dark glossy eyes wears a small explorer hat, walking companionably alongside an alert and friendly dodo bird. The dodo points toward colorful exotic flowers and fruits with a clever, confident smile.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Editorial 3D digital visual. The iconic friendly yellow duck mascot with orange beak, large glossy eyes, feather tuft, and a warm expression wearing a small explorer hat walking through a bright, sunlit tropical island forest. Beside the duck stands a graceful, friendly dodo bird with a clever expression, highlighting its rich senses by discovering vibrant jungle fruits. Warm sunbeams, clean vivid foliage, modern editorial composition, inviting and joyful atmosphere.
concepts.alt_ja: 探検帽をかぶったイエローダックと賢いドードー鳥が陽光の差し込む島の森を歩くイラスト
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck mascot with an explorer hat walking alongside a clever dodo bird through a sunlit tropical forest.

concepts.title_ja: 誤解を解く額縁の公開
concepts.concept_ja: ギャラリーで古い「鈍感なドードー」の埃を拭き取り、中から輝く知的なドードー鳥の真の姿が現れる、歴史の誤解を解く象徴的なビジュアル。
concepts.concept_en: The Daily Duck mascot proudly unveils a vibrant art piece, wiping away dust from an old painting frame to reveal a modern, clever, and sensory-rich dodo bird.
concepts.composition_ja: 洗練されたギャラリー。黄色いダックが柔らかいクロスを手に、古びた額縁の埃を拭き取っています。額縁の中からは、従来のイメージを覆す、瞳を輝かせた賢く魅力的なドードー鳥の姿が鮮やかに現れています。
concepts.composition_en: A sleek modern museum or gallery room. The yellow duck mascot uses a soft cloth to clean an antique painting frame, wiping off dust to reveal a glowing, lively, and intelligent portrait of a dodo bird with sparkled eyes and sensory elements.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Editorial visual concept. The friendly yellow duck mascot with orange beak, large glossy eyes, feather tuft, and a warm smile holding a soft polishing cloth next to a large art frame in a modern gallery. The frame transitions from a dusty antique painting to a bright, vibrant, modern art portrait of a very smart and charming dodo bird surrounded by subtle glowing sensory symbols. Clean lighting, modern graphic design style, storytelling composition.
concepts.alt_ja: イエローダックが額縁を拭き、ドードー鳥の賢く魅力的な真の姿をギャラリーで公開するイラスト
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck mascot in a modern gallery cleaning a frame to reveal a smart and vibrant dodo bird portrait.

concepts.title_ja: 豊かな感覚のオーラ世界
concepts.concept_ja: 香り、音、視覚が優しく彩る夢のような空間で、ダックとドードー鳥が豊かな感覚世界を共に楽しむ、アート的で洗練された概念図。
concepts.concept_en: A whimsical and elegant visual representing the dodo's sensory richness, featuring soft colorful waves of aroma, sound, and light surrounding the duck mascot and dodo.
concepts.composition_ja: パステル調の爽やかで洗練された抽象背景。中央に黄色いダックと賢い表情のドードー鳥が寄り添い、周りには香りを表す花のオーラや音を表す美しい光の波線が優しく立ち込んでいます。
concepts.composition_en: A stylized soft pastel abstract background. In the center, the yellow duck mascot stands wing-in-wing with a smart, joyful dodo bird. Gentle glowing ribbons of light, floating floral scents, and golden sparks represent the rich sensory world discovered by scientists.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Editorial 3D visual representing sensory discovery. The cheerful yellow duck mascot with orange beak, large glossy eyes, small feather tuft, and friendly expression standing next to a clever, charming dodo bird. Around them, soft aesthetic waves of light, gentle pastel aura, floating flower petals, and subtle glowing particles illustrate a rich sensory world. Simple, clean, modern editorial style, vivid soft lighting, warm uplifting mood.
concepts.alt_ja: イエローダックとドードー鳥が光の波や花の香りなど豊かな感覚のオーラに包まれているイラスト
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck mascot and a clever dodo bird standing together surrounded by glowing pastel waves symbolizing rich senses.

concepts.title_ja: ニュースデスクでの真実発表
concepts.concept_ja: ダック記者のデスク上で、ドードー鳥の知性と鋭い感覚を示す明るいポスターを掲示し、長年の誤解が解けたことを伝える解説シーン。
concepts.concept_en: At an editorial desk, the yellow duck mascot points proudly to an informative blueprint and graphics that highlight the dodo bird's sophisticated senses and brain structure.
concepts.composition_ja: 整然としたデスクの上。眼鏡をかけた黄色いダックが、ドードー鳥の優れた視覚や嗅覚を指し示すイラストポスターを誇らしげに指差し、読者に向かって微笑んでいます。
concepts.composition_en: A tidy, stylish editorial news desk. The yellow duck mascot wearing lightweight stylish glasses stands next to a clean, cheerful infographic poster of a dodo bird with glowing markers pointing to its sensory traits.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Editorial newsroom scene. A friendly yellow duck mascot with orange beak, large glossy eyes, feather tuft, and smart look wearing tiny round glasses at a bright wooden desk. The duck points proudly to a clean, colourful infographic poster showing an intelligent dodo bird with glowing icons for smell, sight, and intelligence. Modern clean studio lighting, editorial graphics, shallow depth of field, bright and inviting atmosphere.
concepts.alt_ja: メガネをかけたイエローダックがデスクでドードー鳥の優れた感覚を示すポスターを掲げているイラスト
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck mascot with glasses pointing to an infographic poster illustrating the dodo bird's rich sensory world.
